title: Reliability & Persistence Update
headline: This release fixes several stability issues and ensures your tweak settings stay exactly where you left them across app restarts.
changes: Fixed: Slider and preset tweaks now persist their exact values across app restarts. Previously, settings could reset to default if the registry read failed at startup.

Fixed: Disable NetBIOS and other network tweaks no longer auto-disable themselves after you enable them. The re-check script could falsely report the tweak as off due to adapter-level registry timing.
Fixed: Premium trial expiry now properly reverts slider tweaks and preset profiles, not just toggle tweaks. All premium settings are fully restored on trial end.
Improved: Slider and preset hydration now reads the saved value before querying Windows, so the UI shows your setting instantly even if PowerShell is busy at startup.
Improved: Network tweak verification is smarter — it never overrules a successful apply with a flaky read-back. Your explicit choice always wins.
